task_name: World 110 Task B  -  Square Partial Bank-Feed Observation Hold & Fleet Note Principal/Interest Split
prompt: Perform a comprehensive E-Commerce Payout Ingestion & Debt Amortization review using the world files (`shopify_balance_intake_and_fleet_loan_2026_Q3.xlsx`). Identify all accounting, reconciliation, cutoff, or operational variances; state the exact dollar figures, percentages, and transaction/journal/work-order IDs; propose any required correcting journal entries (with exact Debit and Credit accounts); and enforce all close certification guardrails.

rubric.description: Identifies the 7 matched Square bank purchases ($48,250.00) and 1 offset deposit ($1,420.00) netting to $46,830.00.
Refuses to treat the 7 Square bank debits and 1 offset deposit ($46,830.00 net) as a complete gross/net/tax payroll register before acquiring the tenant Square payroll register.
Identifies fleet note payment CHK-7741 for $2,485.00 erroneously expensed in full to 6310 Auto Loan Expense.
Splits CHK-7741 ($2,485.00) into $1,940.00 principal reduction (2610 Notes Payable  -  Vehicles) and $545.00 interest expense (7110 Interest Expense).
Quantifies the P&L expense overstatement from expensing theCHK-7741 principal reduction as $1,940.00.
Provides the correcting journal entry for CHK-7741: Dr 2610 Notes Payable  -  Vehicles $1,940.00, Dr 7110 Interest Expense $545.00, Cr 6310 Auto Loan Expense $2,485.00.
Explains that an account balance alone does not establish fixed-asset depreciation terms without source asset schedules.
Preserves operator review holds on unverified payroll and asset schedules rather than fabricating synthetic live supporting rows.
